written.summary: An advocate general of the EU’s top court warned that Google’s Gemini chatbot could breach copyright when it reproduces press articles, especially if it bypasses paywalls or copies the expression of the text. Training on copyrighted material is allowed under the text‑and‑data‑mining exception, but using that material to answer users may not be.
